router.security.title: Router security
router.security.intro: For reference: what is already protected and what can be improved. DpiShell does not change these settings — it is your call.
router.security.intro_info: The check only reads router settings. Passwords and Wi‑Fi keys are never shown or included in the report — only “set” or “not set”. Menu names may differ between firmware builds.
router.security.ok_partial: No issues found, some items could not be checked
router.security.root_password.warn: not set — the panel and SSH are open to anyone on the network
router.security.root_password.fix: Option: set a password in the router panel, “System” → “Administration”.
router.security.http_login.ok: off, the panel is HTTPS only
router.security.http_login.warn: the router password travels over the network in plain text: the panel and the DpiShell window on the PC sign in over HTTP
router.security.http_login.https_optiona: the panel has HTTPS, but HTTP sign-in is open: the DpiShell window on the PC and http:// links send the password in plain text
router.security.http_login.fix: Options: HTTPS for the panel with a redirect from HTTP (the browser will warn about a self-signed certificate); SSH key sign-in instead of a password; a guest network for other people’s devices. The DpiShell window on the PC switches to HTTPS by itself and remembers the certificate at the first sign-in.
router.security.panel_listen.warn: listens on all router networks; only the firewall closes it from the internet
router.security.panel_listen.fix: Option: leave only the router’s home network address in the panel web server (uhttpd) settings. If the address changes or access from another network (VPN, guest) is needed, the panel will be unavailable there.
router.security.ssh_listen.ok: listens on the selected interface only
router.security.ssh_listen.warn: listens on all router networks; only the firewall closes it from the internet
router.security.ssh_listen.fix: Option: “System” → “Administration” → “SSH Access”, interface lan. SSH will then be unavailable from VPN and the guest network.
router.security.ssh_password.warn_keys: by password, although an SSH key is already added
router.security.ssh_password.fix: Option: SSH key sign-in with password sign-in turned off. Turn the password off only after checking key sign-in, otherwise SSH is lost until a router reset.
router.security.wan_firewall.ok: incoming connections from the internet are closed
router.security.wan_firewall.warn: the firewall lets incoming connections from the internet through
router.security.wan_firewall.fix: Option: set “Input” and “Forward” of the wan zone to “reject”. If this was opened on purpose (ISP access, your own server), it will be closed.
router.security.wan_admin: Panel and SSH from the internet
router.security.wan_admin.warn: opened by a firewall rule, ports {ports}
router.security.wan_admin.warn_all: a firewall rule opens all router ports to the internet
router.security.wan_admin.fix: Option: turn this rule off (“Network” → “Firewall” → “Traffic Rules”) or allow only the addresses you need. Managing the router from the internet will then stop working.
router.security.port_forwards.warn: rules: {n} — home devices are reachable from the internet on these ports
router.security.port_forwards.fix: Option: check whether all are needed (games, cameras, torrents); turn off the extra ones in “Network” → “Firewall” → “Port Forwards”.
router.security.upnp.warn: on — programs on the network open ports from the internet by themselves
router.security.upnp.warn_insecure: on without secure mode — a device can open a port for another device
router.security.upnp.fix: Option: turn it off if games, consoles and torrents do not need it; otherwise turn on secure mode.
router.security.wifi_encryption.fix: Option: WPA2 (PSK) or WPA2/WPA3 (mixed). After the change all devices reconnect; old ones may not connect at all.
router.security.dns_rebind.warn: off — a website can reach devices on the home network
router.security.dns_rebind.fix: Option: turn it on in “Network” → “DHCP and DNS”. Names that must resolve to internal addresses (corporate VPN, NAS, printer) go to exceptions, otherwise they stop opening.
router.security.dns_wan.local: also listens on the external address, but answers only local networks
router.security.dns_wan.warn: ready to answer queries from the internet if the firewall lets them through
router.security.dns_wan.fix: Option: “Local service only” in “Network” → “DHCP and DNS”, or exclude the wan interface.

DpiShell on the router is reinstalled (about a minute), settings are kept. Optimization restarts for a few seconds. The new version can be installed again with “Update”.

router.rollback.not_saved: The previous packages are not stored on the router — the version can be restored from the DpiShell app on the PC.
router.rollback.no_release: There are no version {version} packages in DpiShell releases — it cannot be restored.
